subject.title: feat(sandbox): add skipSkillsSync config option to suppress skill sync

question: Should preinstalled-skill deployments use a sandbox-backend materialization capability, or should OpenClaw accept `agents.*.sandbox.skipSkillsSync` as a permanent public config contract?
rationale: The patch adds a user-facing configuration surface that weakens the current guarantee that advertised sandbox skills are materialized by OpenClaw; implementation review cannot choose the permanent ownership and failure semantics.

options.title: Use a backend capability
options.body: Let each sandbox backend return prepared readable skill paths and prompt data, avoiding a broad operator flag and silent name-only degradation.

options.title: Sponsor the config contract
options.body: Keep the opt-in flag after separating operator-managed paths from cleanup and proving fresh and repeated sandbox behavior.

options.title: Decline the optimization
options.body: Retain OpenClaw-managed synchronization as the only supported invariant and close this PR and the linked feature request.

recommendation.title: Use a backend capability
recommendation.body: Let each sandbox backend return prepared readable skill paths and prompt data, avoiding a broad operator flag and silent name-only degradation.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed human explicitly asked to review or route this sandbox product-direction choice.
